Bot.//crypto: The locally-deployed C++ server build (Servers/Services) runs with packet encryption OFF, so set NoCrypt=true to talk to it. Leave false for the crypto-on .NET stack / the protocol spec.
Bot.//account: When CreateAccount is true, TBot inserts the account into TGlobal_gsp.TACCOUNT_PW (UPPER SHA1 of Password) before logging in, if it is missing.
Bot.//channel: Valid channels are 1/2/3 (mapped to server ids in TSVRCHART/TCHANNELCHART); channel 0 does not route.
Bot.//character: Used only when the chosen slot has no character yet. Appearance bytes are nation/race dependent; defaults below create a basic Valorian human.
Bot.//movement: Walk a square loop of MoveRadius units around the spawn point. Speed must stay <= 3.40 or the anti-cheat kicks the session.
